_comment: RaceStay event-discovery sources. Used by Claude (manual research) and any future fetcher script. Checked 2026-10-22.

rules.takeFromDiscovery: ONLY the event name (+ the listing URL as a pointer). Never copy descriptions, images or other details.
rules.researchYourself: date, start/finish point + coordinates, distances, start times, province — from official sources (role=verify, organizer site/page).
rules.writeOwnBlurbs: blurbTh / blurbEn are always written by us.
rules.skipVirtual: Skip virtual runs (no physical start). Keywords: virtual, เวอร์ชวล, เสมือน, วิ่งที่ไหนก็ได้, VR, online run.
rules.provenance: Every event in events.json gets source + checkedOn; owner reviews before publishing.
rules.politeFetching: Respect robots.txt, max ~1 request / 3 s per host, cache pages, identify the user agent. Do NOT call private/undocumented APIs (e.g. api.race.thai.run/graphql).

fetchModes.html: Event names are in the server-rendered HTML — fetch with a plain HTTP request.
fetchModes.browser: Page is a JavaScript app (SPA) — render in a browser to read the visible list.
fetchModes.manual: Bot-protected or no stable list — open by hand in a browser.

sources.name: RUNLAH
sources.notes: Best single discovery source: clean type + region filters, covers multisport. Event links are /th/{code}; link text starts with the event name (first segment before tags like 'สมัครทาง RUNLAH' / province). Tested 2026-10-22: works with plain HTTP.

sources.name: ThaiRun (race.thai.run)
sources.notes: Largest Thai registration platform. SPA — data comes from a private GraphQL API; do not call it. Many virtual runs mixed in. Tested 2026-10-22 in browser: lists also contain overseas tour packages (Vientiane, Danang, HCMC, Wuhan, Xiamen) and virtual runs — filter both. Do not call the private GraphQL API.

sources.name: Checkrace
sources.notes: SPA — render in a browser. Tested 2026-10-22: event links /event/{code}; virtual runs live on a separate host vr.checkrace.com — exclude that host.

sources.name: Regis.run
sources.notes: Popular with smaller organizers; homepage lists many events including past ones — filter by date. Tested 2026-10-22: slugs containing 'vr' are virtual (e.g. runnhaideevr); the 'สมัครเข้าร่วม' links duplicate each event — dedupe by URL.

sources.name: ThaiMaster.me / ThaiMTB Event Register
sources.notes: Main source to grow our cycling events. Tested 2026-10-22: link text is '{id}) {name}' — strip the numeric prefix.

sources.name: Ahotu
sources.notes: Very complete global aggregator — use as a gap check. Listings can lag; never trust its dates without verifying. Tested 2026-10-22: Cloudflare verification blocks scripts AND the automated browser — must be opened by a person. Do not try to bypass.

sources.name: World's Marathons
sources.notes: International-runner angle. Tested 2026-10-22: Cloudflare verification blocks the automated browser too — manual only.

sources.name: Finishers
sources.notes: Server-rendered; international-runner angle. Tested 2026-10-22: event links /en/event/{slug}; card text starts with tags/emojis — the clean name follows the tags.

sources.name: VING running calendar articles
sources.notes: Editorial monthly round-ups — good cross-check, not exhaustive. Tested 2026-10-22 in browser: a table of ~280 rows (date | event | venue) — filter rows by month, take the event column only.

sources.name: The Thaiger — marathon guides
sources.notes: English editorial round-up of big Q4 marathons. Tested 2026-10-22: event names are the h3 headings ('Name — Place, Date'); take the part before the dash.

sources.name: UTMB World Series
sources.notes: Official — can confirm dates, distances, start locations for UTMB-series races in Thailand. Tested 2026-10-22: /open-registrations returned an error page; use https://utmb.world/utmb-world-series-events — only Thai event is chiangmai.utmb.world ('Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB').

sources.name: ITRA
sources.notes: Trail race database. Race-finder URL path still to confirm (itra.run/Races/FindRaces returned 404 on 2026-10-22).

sources.name: HYROX Thailand
sources.notes: Official organizer for HYROX races in Thailand. Tested 2026-10-22: race list is https://hyroxthailand.com/find-your-race/ (global list) — Thai race is /event/hyrox-bangkok/ ('BYD HYROX BANGKOK').

sources.name: Thai Cycling Association (สมาคมกีฬาจักรยานแห่งประเทศไทย)
sources.notes: Official association races (road, MTB, track). Tested 2026-10-22: /events lists mostly national championships (track, BMX, balance-bike) — low relevance for travelling amateurs.

officialEventSites._comment: Verified official pages for events already on RaceStay — first stop when verifying facts.
